findings.text: the head-arm gate log carries only its revision and command header, with no pytest summary and no closing EXIT= line, so the manifest's after_suite at 3325edc4d8 (completed true, exit 0) cannot be read from the artefact it names, and the done_when requires each arm's log to carry a closing EXIT=; the 69-pass run exists at b43546e9ef in resume-4.jsonl:1899 and 3325edc4d8 is docs-only, but the named log is still empty.
the gap paragraph says this revision ends 20 % above its fifth pass while the table row at line 30 records 99 MiB to 121 MiB as +22 %, so the landed record contradicts its own measurement.

assert idle["resident_bytes"] == resident compares the record against the value the test itself handed _record_pass_verdicts at line 118, so it reddens only if the recorder drops the key and cannot detect a wrong or zero reading; the value's truth is guarded separately by the idle-reading case.

the done_when's stated negative control (on main after 36c098539b the 50-pass case must fail with memory grown beyond the 10 % band) is not met, because negative-control.log records .F at 36c098539b with only test_an_idle_pass_writes_a_reading_carrying_its_memory failing and the fragment concedes both revisions hold the band on the constant fixture.

resident_bytes re-implements the same VmRSS reader already present at tests/measure_station_tick_at_230_runs.py:50 and the page-count reader at scripts/profile_control_pass.py:347, and no shared owner exists in reckon/, so this is a small duplication rather than a capability fork.
